segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: The first thing on my desk that morning was a handoff note ... That made immediate sense to me ... So I started there.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The participant gives disproportionate weight to the first-received temperature explanation and uses it to prioritize the initial diagnostic search over available alternative evidence.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: My first instinct was that the day-shift operator was less careful ... I focused on him.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: A shift-level defect-rate difference is attributed primarily to the operator's disposition while equipment and chemistry explanations remain underexamined.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: Temperatures stabilized. But pitting didn't disappear ... That told me temperature wasn't the whole story. From there we moved into looking at the dosing system.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: This is a substantive, evidence-responsive update after the chiller intervention; it contains no hidden manifested bias.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: Vendor B ... [had] a stronger spec sheet ... but ... documentation was thin ... Vendor B's ... unresolved gaps still felt less acceptable ... so I didn't take him up on it.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The technically favorable option is rejected in part because its documentation and commissioning information are incomplete, despite an available path to resolve the uncertainty.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: Once I had three sister plants confirming Vendor A worked, that was enough for me ... I didn't finish walking through the rest of the comparison.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: Selection is materially driven by sister-plant adoption and endorsements before the independent technical comparison is completed.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: Having five clean ones in a row felt like the process had settled the score ... another rough batch felt a lot less likely.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The participant treats the sequence of outcomes as statistically compensatory and lowers the estimated probability of a future bad batch.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: I attributed most of the turnaround to the manual rectifier voltage adjustments ... There was a routine bath chemistry replenishment scheduled in there too ... I never really separated the two effects out.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The improvement is overattributed to the participant's manual intervention despite a concurrent uncontrolled chemistry replenishment.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: We hadn't hit the full sample yet. We started prepping the certification paperwork in parallel because the timeline demanded it ... the call [was] open.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: This separates a calendar-driven preparation action from the gambler's-fallacy gut read and does not itself establish a hidden bias.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: The final lot was really what tipped my confidence ... it felt like the truest picture ... the final lot carried most of the weight in my recommendation to certify.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The most recent clean validation lot is weighted more heavily than the fuller two-week trial dataset and the marginal Cpk result.

overall_evaluation_summary.segment_level_primary_result: At the recommended high_and_moderate threshold, 3 of 7 positive segments are detected, with 0 false alarms across 2 negative segments.
overall_evaluation_summary.strict_label_plus_mechanism_result: At high_and_moderate, strict instance scoring yields 2 true positives, 5 false negatives, and 1 false positive; at all identified confidence levels it yields 4 true positives, 3 false negatives, and 2 false positives.
overall_evaluation_summary.mechanism_first_result: At high_and_moderate, mechanism-first scoring yields 3 true positives and no false positives; at all identified confidence levels it yields 6 true positives and 1 false negative.
overall_evaluation_summary.candidate_tier_value_assessment: No candidates were supplied, so the candidate tier adds no detections or errors.
main_failure_modes: Primacy Effect was labeled anchoring bias, producing a strict taxonomy error despite full mechanism and localization overlap.
Illusion of control was labeled self-serving bias, likewise producing a strict taxonomy error despite full mechanism and localization overlap.
Three true-positive findings were low confidence and therefore absent from the recommended high_and_moderate threshold.
main_strengths: All six identified findings are localized to substantively correct interview spans.
Gambler's Fallacy and Recency Effect are exact target-label matches.
The two neighboring-label findings preserve the hidden mechanisms and are recovered by mechanism-first scoring.
No unsupported predictions, invalid quotations, duplicates, or candidate speculations were produced.
overall_evaluation_summary.benchmark_interpretation: This run has strong evidence extraction and localization, but incomplete coverage and two ontology-level label substitutions. Its mechanism-first performance substantially exceeds strict label-plus-mechanism performance once low-confidence findings are included.
